lines.1: 「...Therefore, this sentence translates as, 'Natsuki always gets stuck with the dirty work.'」
lines.9: I trudge out of the classroom.
lines.10: 「Sigh. Maybe I'll have curry before going home...」
lines.12: I'll ask whether she wants dinner.
lines.13: That way I obey her order to go home while still getting to talk with her.
lines.14: What beautiful command of Japanese logic!
lines.15: I turn back toward the classroom.
lines.17: She's looking at that photograph again.
lines.21: 「Would you like to get dinner on the way home?」
lines.25: 「Maybe I'm still a virgin at heart.」
lines.28: 「Would you like to repeat the year?」
lines.31: She returns her gaze to the locket. I think that's what it's called.
lines.39: Maybe that joke was a little dangerous.
lines.40: 「You don't have to get so angry...」
lines.43: 「Does that coldness have something to do with the locket?」
lines.46: A chill runs down my spine.
lines.47: Is that what they call an adult's presence?
lines.48: 「Hey, brat. Looks like you've been pestering Inori.」
